rule: Let L=H diag(g) P where H subtracts channel means and r=beta P. Set g'=-((1-t_d)/t_d)g0, c=sign(beta dot g)||beta||/||g||, beta'=c g'. Set P'=k diag(g')^-1 (L+1 r/(d c)), k=((1-t_m)/t_m)*((1-t_d)/t_d). The complete standalone embedding equals k times the original for every hidden input in exact arithmetic, preserving the normalized readout. Public gain cancels at t_d; projection at t_m contains the centered task difference and a rank-one mean term. Gamma, bias and projection ranges are separate from the frozen A/B. No images, partners or outcomes used to construct.
evaluation: Same two experts, support images, source kernel and coefficients as the previous fixed MNIST ProDistill. Test standalone, direct TA 0.5, two AGA scopes, matched B replacement, and fixed score negation. If still useful, also apply the existing 64-random-input output calibration on frozen merged models. One release only.
scope: Known affine/readout symmetry adapted to two fixed merger operating points. Report the exact tested recovery scope. This does not imply protection against a readout-refitting attacker or arbitrary coefficients.
